health_citations.description: Administer the facility in a manner that enables it to use its resources effectively and efficiently.

Employ or obtain outside professional resources to provide services in the nursing home when the facility does not employ a qualified professional to furnish a required service.
Designate a physician to serve as medical director responsible for implementation of resident care policies and coordination of medical care in the facility.
Provide and implement an infection prevention and control program.

fire_safety_citations.description: Provide exit doors that are held open by devices that will automatically close on the activation of a fire alarm or smoke detector.
Have exits that are accessible at all times.
Ensure that special areas are constructed so that walls can resist fire for one hour or have an approved fire extinguishing system.
Inspect, test, and maintain automatic sprinkler systems.
Properly select, install, inspect, or maintain portable fire extinguishes.
Have restrictions on the use of highly flammable decorations.
Add doors in an exit area that do not require the use of a key from the exit side unless in case of special locking arrangements.
Install emergency lighting that can last at least 1 1/2 hours.
Inspect, test, and maintain automatic sprinkler systems.
Have generator or other power source capable of supplying service within 10 seconds.
Meet requirements for the use of electrical equipment.
Have a complete alarm system manually initiated and initiated by fire sprinkler system connection.

scope_severity_key: A-C no actual harm, potential for minimal harm; D-F potential for more than minimal harm; G-I actual harm; J-L immediate jeopardy. Letters within each group rise from isolated to pattern to widespread.
